artworks.title: The Mill
artworks.artist: British 19th Century after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a windmill on a rocky outcrop overlooking the water. The sky has soft colors, and there is a boat with a figure inside near the shore. Trees can be seen in the background. The color palette is warm and subdued.

artworks.title: The Bristol Riots: The Burning in the Street
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a cobblestone square with a high wall on the left. An old sunlit building with a slanted roof is partly visible. A statue of a human figure with a trident is on a platform at the right. Figures are near a glowing light source, creating plumes of smoke or dust. The brushstrokes are loose and suggestive, with an impressionistic touch. The color palette is subdued with earthy browns and soft blues. In the distance, the sky fades into a pale, cloudy expanse, casting a blue tone over the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon line, distant mountains, a structure among trees and hills, gentle brushstrokes, a monochromatic color palette, rocky patches, sparse vegetation, and a tree on the right.

artworks.title: Angler (Le pecheur a la ligne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a lone figure fishing by a river. The background includes a riverbank and a line of tall trees across the river. The painting uses delicate, etched brushstrokes to depict the trees, foliage, and river. The color palette is mainly black and sepia. The textures created suggest movement in the trees and water, contributing to a calm atmosphere.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodcutter, 2nd plate (Le mort et le bucheron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure in a hooded robe holding a scythe standing over a kneeling man gathering wheat in a natural environment with barren trees and scattered vegetation. The foreground features two primary figures: a skeletal figure on the left and a kneeling man tending to a bundle of wheat on the right. The skeletal figure holds a scythe and appears to be observing the kneeling man. The kneeling man looks startled or afraid, shown by his wide-eyed expression and tense posture. He is in the act of gathering a sheaf of wheat. The background is minimal with leafless trees. The use of line work and cross-hatching creates texture and depth.

artworks.title: Monks at Church (Les moines a l'eglise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of five men seated closely together in front of an object. Each man has a contemplative expression. The central figure appears older with prominent features and shoulder-length hair. The others have varying degrees of balding and wear loose garments resembling robes. One man in the foreground appears to look over the central figure's shoulder. In the background, architectural elements are visible. The artwork is rendered in a linear, crosshatched style typical of etchings, focusing on line work.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree leaning slightly to the left, surrounded by rolling hills, trees, and a castle in the distance. The etching technique creates texture and defines the land and foliage using a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with tall trees creating a natural frame. In the distance, more trees can be seen leaning towards each other. The sky above has swirling cloud-like forms and the overall color palette consists of monochromatic shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Beggar (Un mendiant)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the side, displaying the upper body. The person is looking to the left, with a nose, beard, short hair, and wearing a loose-fitting garment. They hold a hat in their right hand and have their left arm resting on a walking stick. The background is a plain light surface with slight linear textures.

artworks.title: Peddler (Le colporteur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with the horizon near the upper third of the composition. A lone figure is walking with a staff and wearing a broad-brimmed hat. Nearby, there are low bushes or plants. In the distance, there is a cluster of trees with detailed foliage. The image is in monochrome, emphasizing the detailed patterns and shadows, resembling an etching or a sketch approach.

artworks.title: Tower (La tour)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a pastoral scene with a high horizon perspective. The landscape includes hills, a figure leaning on a cane, a winding path, bushes, vegetation, and a small round structure partially hidden by trees. The etching features precise linework detailing the elements, with a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Edge of a Wood (Lisiere de bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with tall trees on both sides. The scene includes dense foliage, with the horizon being partially obscured by the vegetation. The artwork features dynamic cross-hatching brushstrokes that depict the textures of the trees and leaves. The color scheme is predominantly brown and black, creating a sepia-toned effect. In the foreground, there are textured ground and logs.

artworks.title: Small Hill (Le coteau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with softly rolling terrain. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with distant tree lines. The etching technique creates dynamic lines representing trees and vegetation. Bold, expressive lines are used for objects closer to the viewer, with softer strokes for more distant shrubbery. The color palette is monochrome, using black, gray, and white shades to play with light and shadow, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Across Country (A travers champ)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a side angle of a cluster of trees and shrubs. The horizon is in the upper right corner, indicating an open area beyond the foliage. The etching technique creates depth and texture in the vegetation. The color scheme is mainly dark blacks and earthy tones against a lighter background, highlighting the contrast and depth of the lines. The foreground features detailed, twisted branches and foliage, with dynamic brush strokes. In the background, less detailed lines suggest a more open space compared to the dense vegetation in the foreground.

artworks.title: Edge of a Forest in Bourgogne (Un coin de foret en Bourgogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure carrying long pieces of wood in a forest with a dense canopy of tall trees. The scene is depicted from a low point of view with intricate and detailed brushwork or etching style. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia or dark brown, creating a contrast between light and dark areas.

artworks.title: Roman Ruin (Ruine romaine)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees, shrubs, and rocks. There are hills in the distance and a sky overhead. The artwork is created using detailed etching with visible lines showcasing textures and depth. The color palette consists of shades of black and gray, creating contrast.

artworks.title: Little Wandering Jew (Le petit juif errant)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a traveler walking with a stick along a path. The background features a large, twisting tree trunk. The artwork uses detailed cross-hatching lines to create texture and depth in the tree's bark and the traveler's clothing. The monochromatic palette emphasizes contrasts and adds a dramatic tone to the setting.

artworks.title: Woods in Winter Sun, 2nd plate (Soleil d'hiver dans les bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome etching depicting a dense forest scene. The scene shows trees and undergrowth, with detailed textures and patterns. Tall trees are visible, with branches forming intricate patterns against a pale background. The horizon is obscured by the dense arrangement of trees. The etching uses a restricted color palette of black and off-white, creating a high-contrast image that emphasizes light, shadow, foliage details, and tree forms.

artworks.title: Farm on a Hill (La ferme sur la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene with hills in the distance. A detailed tree is on the left, and a figure in a wide-brimmed hat sits near a horse in the center. On a hill in the distance, a faintly outlined building is visible. The etching technique creates texture through cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Old Chateau (Un vieux chateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching presenting a landscape view from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is near the upper third where the sky meets the distant land without distinct separation. The field of view is dominated by indistinct forms, with faint outlines of possibly distant trees or terrain on the horizon. The etching technique employs fine, closely spaced lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth on the terrain, castle, and foliage. Two figures recline against the slope, directing attention towards the middle of the scene. In the distance, a slope leads to an elevated structure, likely a castle with battlements, blending into the background through fine line work. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray on a light background, creating a serene visual effect.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 4th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's head and shoulders in profile view. His head is turned slightly to his left, and he has prominent facial features including high cheekbones, a prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. He has a full head of hair, a large white beard and mustache covering much of his face and neck. He is dressed in a high-collared garment. The background is textured with cross-hatching and the overall tone is monochromatic, using various shades of black and white. There are no visible signs of jewelry, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Bend in the River (Un coin de riviere)
artworks.medium: etching retouched with sepia ink and wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with trees partially covering the horizon. A figure is in a boat in the center, close to the viewer. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting foliage and water with crosshatching. Earth tones dominate the color palette, creating a peaceful atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bridge at the Mill (Le pont du moulin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic scene with buildings on the left side blending into the natural surroundings. The horizon is not clearly visible due to trees and foliage. The etching technique is used with meticulous and textured brushstrokes, including cross-hatching for depth and shading. The color palette is monochrome with shades of grey. A large tree dominates the center, with a path leading through the landscape to distant hills.

artworks.title: Bridge at the Mill (Le pont du moulin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: In the image, there is a wooded area with trees and a building. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The horizon is not clearly visible. There is a rustic building on the left with a thatched roof, partly hidden by trees. The artwork shows detailed cross-hatched brushstrokes creating textures and shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic, using different shades of gray. The image features dense foliage and architectural elements depicted closely, extending into the distance with more trees in the background.
